questions.question_bn: Rest থেকে constant acceleration 4 m/s²। 4-তম second-এ distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। s((4))−s((4)−1)=2×(4)²−2((4)−1)²=4×(4)−2। মোট distance আর nth-second distance আলাদা।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: A t=0-এ constant 4 m/s-এ যায়। একই origin থেকে B rest-এ, acceleration 2 m/s², delay 11 s পরে শুরু। B start-এর τ পরে catch হলে কোন equation?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। B-এর distance ½·2τ²=τ²। A-এর elapsed time τ+(11), distance 4(τ+(11)); origins same।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Particle rest থেকে 2 m/s²-এ 5 s accelerate করে, তারপর same speed-এ 3 s চলে। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Acceleration stage s₁=½at²=(5)², final v=2×(5)। uniform stage s₂=v·3=6×(5); total যোগ।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: x(t)=10t³−2t²+t। t=1-এ acceleration কত?

questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: v(t)=11−2t m/s, 0≤t≤11 s। total distance কত m?

questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: এক car speed 6 m/s থেকে 4 m/s² deceleration-এ থামে। stopping distance কত m?

questions.question_bn: Twoobjectsrestdropfromsameheight,second released 1slater। firstelapsedt=3s (>1),g10,bothinair। separation কত m?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। B-এর distance ½·2τ²=τ²। A-এর elapsed time τ+(9), distance 4(τ+(9)); origins same।

questions.question_bn: Horizontalplatformspeed 8 m/s। vertical relative-throwu=20 m/s,g10,landingbacksameheight। ground frame displacement কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Flight time 2uy/g=4s। horizontalgroundspeedplatformnconstant(noairresistance),range 4×(8); relativeframethrowverticaldoesnotzeroabsolutevx।

questions.question_bn: Rest থেকে constant acceleration 4 m/s²। 5-তম second-এ distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। s((5))−s((5)−1)=2×(5)²−2((5)−1)²=4×(5)−2। মোট distance আর nth-second distance আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Particle rest থেকে 2 m/s²-এ 8 s accelerate করে, তারপর same speed-এ 3 s চলে। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Acceleration stage s₁=½at²=(8)², final v=2×(8)। uniform stage s₂=v·3=6×(8); total যোগ।
